006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter.MetaschemaDataTypeProvider;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype.object.AmbiguousTime;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.DateTimeFunctionException;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidValueForCastFunctionException;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.impl.TimeWithoutTimeZoneItemImpl;
014import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
015import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
016import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
017
018import java.time.LocalTime;
019import java.time.OffsetTime;
020import java.time.ZoneOffset;
021
022import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
023import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
024
025/**
026 * An atomic Metapath item representing a time value in the Metapath system.
027 * <p>
028 * This interface provides functionality for handling time values with and
029 * without time zone information, supporting parsing, casting, and comparison
030 * operations. It works in conjunction with {@link AmbiguousTime} to properly
031 * handle time zone ambiguity.
032 */
033public interface ITimeItem extends ITemporalItem {
034  /**
035   * Get the type information for this item.
036   *
037   * @return the type information
038   */
039  @NonNull
040  static IAtomicOrUnionType<ITimeItem> type() {
041    return MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.TIME.getItemType();
042  }
043
044  @Override
045  default IAtomicOrUnionType<? extends ITimeItem> getType() {
046    return type();
047  }
048
049  /**
050   * Construct a new date/time item using the provided string {@code value}.
051   *
052   * @param value
053   *          a string representing a time
054   * @return the new item
055   */
056  @NonNull
057  static ITimeItem valueOf(@NonNull String value) {
058    try {
059      return valueOf(MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.TIME.parse(value));
060    } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
061      throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
062          null,
063          String.format("Invalid date/time value '%s'. %s",
064              value,
065              ex.getLocalizedMessage()),
066          ex);
067    }
068  }
069
070  /**
071   * Construct a new time item using the provided {@code value}.
072   * <p>
073   * This method handles recording if an explicit timezone was provided using the
074   * {@code hasTimeZone} parameter. The {@link AmbiguousTime#hasTimeZone()} method
075   * can be called to determine if timezone information is present.
076   *
077   * @param value
078   *          a time, without time zone information
079   * @param hasTimeZone
080   *          {@code true} if the date/time is intended to have an associated time
081   *          zone or {@code false} otherwise
082   * @return the new item
083   * @see AmbiguousTime for more details on timezone handling
084   */
085  @NonNull
086  static ITimeItem valueOf(@NonNull OffsetTime value, boolean hasTimeZone) {
087    return hasTimeZone
088        ? ITimeWithTimeZoneItem.valueOf(value)
089        : valueOf(new AmbiguousTime(value, false));
090  }
091
092  /**
093   * Construct a new time item using the provided {@code value}.
094   * <p>
095   * This method handles recording if an explicit timezone was provided using the
096   * {@link AmbiguousTime}. The {@link AmbiguousTime#hasTimeZone()} method can be
097   * called to determine if timezone information is present.
098   *
099   * @param value
100   *          a time, without time zone information
101   * @return the new item
102   * @see AmbiguousTime for more details on timezone handling
103   */
104  @NonNull
105  static ITimeItem valueOf(@NonNull AmbiguousTime value) {
106    return value.hasTimeZone()
107        ? ITimeWithTimeZoneItem.valueOf(value.getValue())
108        : new TimeWithoutTimeZoneItemImpl(value);
109  }
110
111  @Override
112  default boolean hasDate() {
113    return false;
114  }
115
116  @Override
117  default boolean hasTime() {
118    return true;
119  }
120
121  @Override
122  boolean hasTimezone();
123
124  @Override
125  default int getYear() {
126    return 0;
127  }
128
129  @Override
130  default int getMonth() {
131    return 0;
132  }
133
134  @Override
135  default int getDay() {
136    return 0;
137  }
138
139  @Override
140  default int getHour() {
141    return asOffsetTime().getHour();
142  }
143
144  @Override
145  default int getMinute() {
146    return asOffsetTime().getMinute();
147  }
148
149  @Override
150  default int getSecond() {
151    return asOffsetTime().getSecond();
152  }
153
154  @Override
155  default int getNano() {
156    return asOffsetTime().getNano();
157  }
158
159  @Override
160  @Nullable
161  default ZoneOffset getZoneOffset() {
162    return hasTimezone() ? asOffsetTime().getOffset() : null;
163  }
164
165  /**
166   * Get the underlying time value.
167   *
168   * @return the time value
169   */
170  @NonNull
171  OffsetTime asOffsetTime();
172
173  /**
174   * Adjusts an xs:dateTime value to a specific timezone, or to no timezone at
175   * all.
176   * <p>
177   * This method does one of the following things based on the arguments.
178   * <ol>
179   * <li>If the provided offset is {@code null} and the provided date/time value
180   * has a timezone, the timezone is maked absent.
181   * <li>If the provided offset is {@code null} and the provided date/time value
182   * has an absent timezone, the date/time value is returned.
183   * <li>If the provided offset is not {@code null} and the provided date/time
184   * value has an absent timezone, the date/time value is returned with the new
185   * timezone applied.
186   * <li>Otherwise, the provided timezone is applied to the date/time value
187   * adjusting the time instant.
188   * </ol>
189   * <p>
190   * Implements the XPath 3.1 <a href=
191   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-adjust-dateTime-to-timezone">fn:adjust-dateTime-to-timezone</a>
192   * function.
193   *
194   * @param offset
195   *          the timezone offset to use or {@code null}
196   * @return the adjusted date/time value
197   * @throws DateTimeFunctionException
198   *           with code
199   *           {@link DateTimeFunctionException#INVALID_TIME_ZONE_VALUE_ERROR} if
200   *           the offset is &lt; -PT14H or &gt; PT14H
201   */
202  @Override
203  default ITimeItem replaceTimezone(@Nullable IDayTimeDurationItem offset) {
204    return offset == null
205        ? hasTimezone()
206            ? valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(asOffsetTime().withOffsetSameLocal(ZoneOffset.UTC)), false)
207            : this
208        : hasTimezone()
209            ? valueOf(IDateTimeItem.valueOf(MetapathConstants.REFERENCE_DATE_ITEM, this)
210                .replaceTimezone(offset).asOffsetTime(),
211                true)
212            : valueOf(
213                ObjectUtils.notNull(asOffsetTime().withOffsetSameLocal(offset.asZoneOffset())),
214                true);
215  }
216
217  /**
218   * Cast the provided type to this item type.
219   *
220   * @param item
221   *          the item to cast
222   * @return the original item if it is already this type, otherwise a new item
223   *         cast to this type
224   * @throws InvalidValueForCastFunctionException
225   *           if the provided {@code item} cannot be cast to this type
226   */
227  @NonNull
228  static ITimeItem cast(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item) {
229    ITimeItem retval;
230    if (item instanceof ITimeItem) {
231      retval = (ITimeItem) item;
232    } else if (item instanceof IStringItem || item instanceof IUntypedAtomicItem) {
233      try {
234        retval = valueOf(item.asString());
235      } catch (IllegalStateException | InvalidTypeMetapathException ex) {
236        // asString can throw IllegalStateException exception
237        throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(ex);
238      }
239    } else {
240      throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(
241          String.format("unsupported item type '%s'", item.getClass().getName()));
242    }
243    return retval;
244  }
245
246  @Override
247  default ITimeItem castAsType(IAnyAtomicItem item) {
248    return cast(item);
249  }
250
251  /**
252   * Get the time as a {@link LocalTime}.
253   *
254   * @return the date
255   */
256  @NonNull
257  default LocalTime asLocalTime() {
258    return ObjectUtils.notNull(asOffsetTime().toLocalTime());
259  }
260}
